title: Skill distribution: stop copying, fetch at boot
description: Research dated 10 October 2026. One public catalog with pinned Mac installs and a static cloud bootstrap line is the source recommendation; nothing changed.

props.text: Use local gh PRs from Iury's account, not a shared write token. Keep repo-local product skills. A Mac bump command should resolve HEAD, update lock and catalog docs, then apply; agents2 update currently mishandles git pins.

ai-artifacts/node-redesign/sources/4-decision-comparison.md, summarizing distribution-options.md dated 10 October 2026. Research only; nothing changed. The existing process also keeps source, agents2/content/skills, consumer copies and an installed pinned snapshot aligned by tests and provenance. MCP is a poor fit because skill discovery reads disk files and skills can include scripts.
